**Texere 0.4.11** · 11 November 2026

- **First steps, clearer.** On the home page, a thin line shows how far you are; the next step stands out, with one line on how to do it and a link that takes you there (Open References, Open the PDF, New note, Open Export). Done steps are checked, the rest wait, faded.

Also in this version (from 0.4.10): a shorter setup with the Texere structure preselected; the map's fields reach your reading notes.

Update: the **Update** button on Texere's home page, or BRAT at startup.
